blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) said that Culiat Bridge II along Congressional Avenue in Quezon City will be open to buses on Saturday, Nov. 7. Newly appointed Public Works and Highways Secretary Giovanni Lopez ordered the reopening of the bridge starting at 6 a.m. on Saturday. READ: Culiat Bridge II in QC reopens to light vehicles after 2-week repair The lifting of the temporary order follows the completion of the testing and analytical load rating conducted to buses to ensure the safety of motorists.
